source.text_it: L’instabilità di marcia del veicolo può dipendere dal sistema di regolazione delle sospensioni pneumatiche malfunzionante

records.localized_text: Vehicle instability may be caused by a malfunctioning air suspension control system.

source.text_it: Gli ammortizzatori scarichi possono provocare anomale oscillazioni del veicolo

records.localized_text: Worn shock absorbers can cause abnormal vehicle oscillation.

source.text_it: Gli ammortizzatori scarichi comportano una maggiore rumorosità del veicolo

records.localized_text: Worn shock absorbers cause greater vehicle noise.

source.text_it: Gli ammortizzatori scarichi possono provocare un anomalo orientamento del fascio di luce dei proiettori anabbaglianti

records.localized_text: Worn shock absorbers can cause abnormal alignment of the dipped-beam headlights.

source.text_it: Gli ammortizzatori scarichi possono provocare un anomalo consumo del battistrada

records.localized_text: Worn shock absorbers can cause abnormal tread wear.

source.text_it: L’instabilità di marcia del veicolo può dipendere da scarsità di olio nel circuito di lubrificazione del motore

records.localized_text: Vehicle instability may be caused by insufficient oil in the engine lubrication circuit.

source.text_it: La stabilità del veicolo è indipendente dalle modalità di posizionamento del carico

records.localized_text: Vehicle stability is independent of how the load is positioned.

source.text_it: Gli ammortizzatori scarichi provocano un notevole risparmio di carburante

records.localized_text: Worn shock absorbers provide considerable fuel savings.

source.text_it: Gli ammortizzatori scarichi garantiscono un miglior comfort dei passeggeri perché rendono meno rigido il veicolo

records.localized_text: Worn shock absorbers improve passenger comfort because they make the vehicle less rigid.

source.text_it: L’instabilità di marcia del veicolo può dipendere dall'utilizzo di pneumatici invernali in una giornata in cui la temperatura dell'asfalto è di circa 25°C

records.localized_text: Vehicle instability may be caused by using winter tires on a day when the asphalt temperature is approximately 25°C.

source.text_it: L’instabilità di marcia del veicolo può dipendere dall’impianto di navigazione malfunzionante

records.localized_text: Vehicle instability may be caused by a malfunctioning navigation system.

source.text_it: La non corretta convergenza delle ruote anteriori determina l’asimmetrico consumo degli pneumatici

records.localized_text: Incorrect front wheel toe causes uneven tire wear.

source.text_it: L’eccessiva pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici provoca una maggiore rigidità di marcia, con minor confort per i passeggeri

records.localized_text: Excessive tire inflation pressure makes the ride stiffer and less comfortable for passengers.

source.text_it: Un’insufficiente pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici provoca un aumento della deriva con conseguente minor tenuta di strada in curva

records.localized_text: Insufficient tire inflation pressure increases side slip, reducing grip on bends.

source.text_it: La mancata equilibratura dello pneumatico ne provoca un anomalo consumo e una vibrazione dello sterzo

records.localized_text: An unbalanced tire causes abnormal wear and steering vibration.

source.text_it: Le ruote gemellate, se poco gonfie, possono deteriorarsi a causa del loro reciproco sfregamento

records.localized_text: Underinflated dual tires can deteriorate because they rub against each other.

source.text_it: Se il conducente di un veicolo aziendale, durante un'ispezione, nota anomali consumi degli pneumatici, deve immediatamente riferirlo al responsabile del parco veicolare

records.localized_text: If a company vehicle driver notices abnormal tyre wear during inspection, they must immediately report it to the fleet manager.

source.text_it: Se il conducente, durante un'ispezione al veicolo, nota forte riscaldamento di alcune parti degli pneumatici, deve evitare di riprendere il viaggio riferendo all’azienda della situazione

records.localized_text: If a driver inspecting a vehicle notices that parts of the tires are excessively hot, they must not resume the journey and must inform the company.

source.text_it: La perdita di convergenza del veicolo diminuisce il rischio di sbandamento del veicolo, ma ne aumenta il consumo

records.localized_text: Loss of correct wheel toe reduces the risk of skidding but increases consumption.

source.text_it: La non corretta equilibratura delle ruote diminuisce lo spazio di frenatura del veicolo, ma porta a fenomeni di vibrazione allo sterzo

records.localized_text: Incorrect wheel balancing shortens braking distance but causes steering vibration.

source.text_it: Un’insufficiente pressione di gonfiaggio degli pneumatici, provoca un aumento di temperatura del liquido di raffreddamento

records.localized_text: Insufficient tire inflation pressure increases coolant temperature.

source.text_it: Il conducente che noti un differente consumo delle varie zone del battistrada deve immediatamente sospendere il viaggio e attendere soccorsi

records.localized_text: A driver noticing uneven wear across the tread must immediately suspend the journey and await assistance.

source.text_it: Il conducente che noti un differente consumo delle varie zone del battistrada, deve immediatamente cambiare lo pneumatico in oggetto con quello di scorta

records.localized_text: A driver noticing uneven wear across the tread must immediately replace that tire with the spare.

source.text_it: Il conducente che noti un differente consumo delle varie zone del battistrada, deve immediatamente scaricare la merce o i passeggeri e avvisare l'azienda perché provveda al recupero e proseguire il viaggio a vuoto

records.localized_text: A driver noticing uneven wear across the tread must immediately unload the goods or passengers, notify the company to arrange recovery, and continue the journey empty.

source.text_it: Per garantire la sicurezza della circolazione è necessario, fra l’altro, mantenere libero il campo di visibilità del conducente

records.localized_text: To ensure traffic safety, among other things, keep the driver's field of vision clear.

rows.text: The control system maintains air-suspension height. If it malfunctions, the vehicle’s stance and stability can suffer.
evidence: https://www.hse.gov.uk/safetybulletins/air-suspension-systems-on-vehicles.htm — air suspension maintains ride height

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/1154772/categorisation-of-vehicle-defects.pdf — IM 48: defective levelling linkage can adversely affect stability

rows.text: Shock absorbers damp suspension oscillations. When worn, the vehicle can continue bouncing after a disturbance.
evidence: https://www.monroe.com/technical-resources/shocks-101/symptoms-worn-shock-struts.html — worn shocks permit bouncing

rows.text: Worn shock absorbers or their mounts can cause noise as the suspension moves without proper control.
evidence: https://www.monroe.com/technical-resources/shocks-101/what-causes-shocks-struts-to-wear-out.html — worn shock bushings cause noise and excessive bouncing

rows.text: If the suspension oscillates excessively, the body’s angle changes, as does the direction of the headlight beam.
evidence: https://www.monroe.com/en-eu/support/technical-tips/lv/shock-absorbers/safety-indicators.html — worn struts can affect ride height and headlight beam

rows.text: Worn shock absorbers control wheel contact with the road less effectively; bouncing can cause uneven tread wear.
evidence: https://www.monroe.com/technical-resources/shocks-101/symptoms-worn-shock-struts.html — bouncing reduces road holding and causes cupped tire wear

rows.text: Engine oil lubricates engine parts, and too little can damage them. Stability depends instead on factors such as tire and suspension condition.
evidence: https://www.castrol.com/en_gb/united-kingdom/home/learn/car-maintenance/how-to-top-up-your-engine-oil.html — engine oil lubricates engine components
https://www.monroe.com/technical-resources/shocks-101/symptoms-worn-shock-struts.html — worn shocks affect road holding

rows.text: Load placement affects the center of gravity and stability. Keeping the load low and near the center line helps keep the vehicle stable.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/securing-loads-on-hgvs-and-goods-vehicles/2-load-securing-the-basics — low, central load helps stability

rows.text: Worn shock absorbers do not guarantee fuel savings: they control oscillations less effectively and can impair road holding.
evidence: https://www.monroe.com/technical-resources/shocks-101/symptoms-worn-shock-struts.html — worn shocks cause bouncing and reduced road holding

rows.text: Less damping does not improve comfort: it allows the body to continue oscillating and bouncing.
evidence: https://www.monroe.com/technical-resources/shocks-101/symptoms-worn-shock-struts.html — worn shocks cause bouncing and a rough ride

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but an asphalt temperature of 25°C alone cannot diagnose instability. On warm roads winter tyres can make handling less precise, depending on the tyre and manoeuvre, so the sources consulted do not rule out the possibility described.
evidence: Official superiori question 30879 printed FALSO says winter tires may contribute to instability with asphalt about 25°C; it expresses possibility, not certainty or a general temperature law. Intended official scope is unknown.

Continental https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/winter-tires-in-summer/ — warm dry pavement can reduce steering precision and handling/stability for winter tires, especially in critical maneuvers. General manufacturer advice, no exact 25°C asphalt test or universal instability established.
Michelin https://www.michelin.it/auto/consigli/guida-gomme-invernali/gomme-invernali-in-estate — discusses warm-season handling tradeoffs; does not establish impossibility of the quiz scenario.

rows.text: A navigation system gives route guidance but does not control the vehicle’s stance. Stability depends on factors such as tires and suspension.
evidence: https://www.monroe.com/technical-resources/shocks-101/symptoms-worn-shock-struts.html — suspension condition affects road holding
https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-damage/car-handling-problems — tire condition affects handling

rows.text: Incorrect toe alignment makes the wheels run at the wrong angles and can wear the tread edges unevenly.
evidence: https://business.michelin.co.uk/help-advice/truck/tyre-wear-uneven-truck-tyre-wear — excessive toe causes shoulder wear

rows.text: Excessive pressure makes the tire less able to absorb impacts, producing a harsher and less comfortable ride.
evidence: https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/inv/2023/INRD-PE23008-10381.pdf — tire pressure section: overinflation reduces cushioning and causes uncomfortable ride

rows.text: An underinflated tire deforms more sideways. More steering is needed for the same cornering force, and road holding can worsen.
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/tirepressure-fmvss-138.pdf — V-55: low pressure reduces cornering stiffness and requires more steering angle

rows.text: Wheel imbalance can cause vibration, including at the steering wheel, and uneven tread wear.
evidence: https://dxm.contentcenter.michelin.com/api/wedia/dam/variation/micasset/659014/original — p. 8: imbalance causes steering difficulty and irregular wear
https://www.michelinman.com/auto/assistance/michelin-faqs — unbalanced assemblies can vibrate

rows.text: When dual tires are underinflated, their sidewalls can deform until they touch. Rubbing wears them and can damage them.
evidence: https://dgaddcosprod.blob.core.windows.net/b2b-experience-production/attachments/cmne707tk049d01hzolpawew2-truck-tyres-technical-data-book-2023-en.pdf — p. 79: underinflation may cause dual tires to contact and wear sidewalls

rows.text: Abnormal wear can indicate a pressure or alignment problem. Report it to the person responsible so it can be checked and corrected.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-daily-heavy-goods-vehicle-hgv-walkaround-checks — report defects to person responsible
https://business.michelin.co.uk/help-advice/truck/tyre-wear-uneven-truck-tyre-wear — irregular wear may indicate pressure or alignment problems

rows.text: Excessive heat can indicate tire damage, including internal damage. Do not resume the trip; inform the company and have the tire checked.
evidence: https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure — abnormally hot tire must be removed and checked; heat can damage internal components
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-daily-heavy-goods-vehicle-hgv-walkaround-checks — report defects

rows.text: Incorrect toe alignment can cause wear and impair steering precision; it does not reduce the risk of skidding.
evidence: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-damage/car-handling-problems — misalignment accelerates edge wear and reduces steering precision

rows.text: Imbalance can cause vibration and uneven wear, but it is not a device that shortens braking distance.
evidence: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-maintenance/wheel-alignment-wheel-balancing — balancing prevents irregular wear and vibration

rows.text: Low pressure makes the tire flex and heat up; it is not a direct cause of increased engine coolant temperature.
evidence: https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/inv/2023/INRD-PE23008-10381.pdf — tire pressure section: underinflation increases flex and can overheat tire

rows.text: Uneven wear calls for inspection of the tire and possible causes. It does not always require stopping on the spot and waiting for assistance: the defect’s severity matters.
evidence: https://business.michelin.co.uk/help-advice/truck/tyre-wear-uneven-truck-tyre-wear — identify wear causes and correct them
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-daily-heavy-goods-vehicle-hgv-walkaround-checks — report defects; safety depends on defect

rows.text: Uneven wear and its cause must be checked. Immediate replacement with the spare is not automatically necessary; it depends on the tire’s condition.
evidence: https://business.michelin.co.uk/help-advice/truck/tyre-wear-uneven-truck-tyre-wear — investigate and correct uneven wear
https://www.michelinman.com/auto/assistance/michelin-faqs — exposed cords require replacement

rows.text: Uneven wear should be reported and assessed. It does not automatically require immediately unloading goods or passengers and continuing empty.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-daily-heavy-goods-vehicle-hgv-walkaround-checks — report defects for assessment
https://business.michelin.co.uk/help-advice/truck/tyre-wear-uneven-truck-tyre-wear — uneven wear has various causes to address

rows.text: The driver must be able to see the road and other road users. Obstructions in the field of view can hide hazards and delay reactions.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/mot-inspection-manual-for-private-passenger-and-light-commercial-vehicles/3-visibility — section 3.1: inspect driver’s field of vision; significant obstruction affects road view

review.author: gpt-6.1-terra / collaboration /root/terra_author
reviewer_evidence: Independently checked all 25 source questions and four language variants; no source figures. Continental https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/winter-tires-in-summer/ section 3 expressly says winter tyres on warm dry pavement can yield less responsive handling; Michelin https://www.michelin.it/auto/consigli/guida-gomme-invernali/gomme-invernali-in-estate discusses warm-weather limitations. Neither establishes the exact asphalt 25°C case. 30879 preserves printed FALSO and explicitly states the stated possibility is not ruled out, without treating the specific condition as diagnosed or confusing air and pavement temperature.

Monroe https://www.monroe.com/en-eu/support/technical-tips/lv/shock-absorbers/safety-indicators.html directly discusses worn struts affecting headlight projected beam; https://www.monroe.com/technical-resources/shocks-101/symptoms-worn-shock-struts.html describes excessive bounce and cupping. The 30873 link from excessive pitch to headlight direction follows mechanically; no claim of a constant misalignment.

NHTSA https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/tirepressure-fmvss-138.pdf printed V-55 directly supports low-pressure cornering-stiffness relation. Michelin https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-the-right-pressure explicitly calls for removal and inspection if one tyre is much hotter than others, and describes internal heat damage. Michelin https://www.michelinb2b.com/wps/b2bcontent/PDF/TECHNICAL_Usage_and_Maintenance_Guide.pdf p.50 indexed primary text provides an industrial dual-tyre example of underinflation increasing sidewall contact and rubbing. NHTSA INRD-PE23008-10381.pdf exceeded browser size; other accessible technical evidence used for core mechanism.

issues.reason: Il quiz indica FALSO per la possibilità che pneumatici invernali su asfalto a circa 25 °C contribuiscano all’instabilità. Le fonti tecniche indicano prestazioni e tenuta potenzialmente inferiori a temperature elevate; non stabiliscono che ciò non possa influire sulla stabilità. Non è chiaro quale distinzione giustifichi il verdetto stampato.
checked_sources: Commissione europea, studio TNO 2014 R11423-v2, https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/system/files/2021-07/study_tyres_2014.pdf, figura 3.6: esempi di prove a 20–25 °C con prestazioni diverse tra gomme estive e invernali; migliori prestazioni estive ad alte temperature.

VTI rapport 1092A, https://vti.diva-portal.org/smash/get/diva2%3A1641512/FULLTEXT01.pdf: prove su asfalto estivo mostrano spazi di frenata maggiori per pneumatici invernali; la fonte non risolve il significato preciso di instabilità nel quesito.
